snippet.title: General Practice - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Play demo on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3833730/General_Practice/

Diagnose and (mis)treat patients to meet tight deadlines and high expectations in this fast-paced wacky medical co-op adventure. Wear many hats, master numerous tools, multitask, manage the chaos: all for the greater good (and monthly bonus)! Play solo or with up to 4 friends, locally or online. 

Follow Mokum Games:
Twitter: https://x.com/MokumGames
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/mokumgames.bsky.social
Discord: https://mokum.games/discord
Website: https://mokum.games/
